phase: Phase 5 — Knowledge Retrieval & Cognitive Context Engine
phase_4_source: Explicit opt-in memory proposal extraction; proposals require owner approval before becoming private memories
Sensitive-looking phrases are excluded by a conservative heuristic
Pending proposals can be reviewed from Android Memory screen or chat approval dialog
Per-user normalized SHA-256 memory deduplication and duplicate merge on edit
Deterministic importance scoring and configurable memory expiry
Semantic retrieval excludes unapproved and expired memories
Shared-knowledge submission queue with Firebase UID reviewer allowlist
Reviewer approve/reject audit trail; only approved content enters shared_knowledge
Database migration 004 and RLS smoke-test additions
security_notes: User identity is derived from verified Firebase token and internal PostgreSQL UUID.
Memory proposals and submissions are user-scoped using transaction-local RLS.
Only server-side allowlisted Firebase UIDs can review shared-knowledge submissions.
Personal memories are not promoted to shared knowledge automatically.
Runtime DB role must not own protected tables or have SUPERUSER/BYPASSRLS.
Reviewer allowlist, service-account credentials, database URLs and model keys stay on backend.
phase_5_source: Separate authenticated per-user private-memory retrieval and globally approved shared-knowledge retrieval
Semantic shared-knowledge retrieval with PostgreSQL full-text fallback
Weighted ranking using similarity, memory importance and reviewer confidence
Conservative potential-conflict signal; model instructed to express uncertainty
Approval-time shared-knowledge embedding and normalized duplicate prevention
Migration 005 and Indonesian step-by-step installation/run guide
